response.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT o.ordertune, COUNT(DISTINCT o.recordvault) AS n FROM orders o JOIN riskandmargin r ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.ordertune), a AS (SELECT AVG(n) AS avg_n FROM c) SELECT AVG(c.n) AS avg_count, AVG(c.n - a.avg_n) AS avg_excess FROM c, a WHERE c.n > a.avg_n

assumptions.assumption: Distinct orders are identified by recordvault (the unique order reference), not orderspivot.
Order types with a NULL ordertune form their own group and are included in the average across types.
The average across types is the simple average of the per-type distinct order counts, over types that have at least one matched order.
